description: Sampers is the Swedish Transport Administration's national model system for cross-modal analysis of passenger transport. Contents: it forecasts future traffic volumes under scenarios that vary infrastructure, GDP, fuel prices, employment and population, and feeds the Samkalk module for cost-benefit calculation; modules include the Emme assignment tool and a timetable application. Version 2026.1 runs with OpenPaths Emme 25.01.00, and Sampers 4 is built on a synthetic population, with regional demand models and a long-distance model; documentation includes a user manual, input and coding principles, technical documentation, calibration and elasticity reports. Coverage: Sweden, used for the national base forecasts. Format and access: documentation is free as PDFs; the model and current base forecast are provided on request through Trafikverket's Sampers management. Licence and cost: not stated; Emme is commercial software. Caveats: most documents are in Swedish, and a known Emme bug affects population synthesis in the current version. Used for capacity planning and network flow analysis of major investments, transport policy and land use change. It relates to the Samgods national freight model and the Swiss national passenger model in the catalogue.
